posting.title: Professional Services Technical Architect - West
posting.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


AN OVERVIEW OF THIS ROLE

As a Professional Services Technical Architect at GitLab, you'll lead the technical direction of customer engagements from early scoping and discovery through delivery. You'll design high-level architectures and implementation plans for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, and you'll make sure deliverables align with customer requirements and the Statement of Work (SOW). You'll coordinate and guide implementation work across GitLab Professional Services and partner consultants, support customers deploying GitLab in cloud and on-premises environments using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit, and perform migrations to GitLab using Congregate. You'll provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best practices, contribute reusable collateral such as documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and share product release updates to help the team deliver consistent outcomes. This role combines deep technical expertise with customer-facing leadership in GitLab's remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 * Designing and delivering GitLab reference architecture implementations for both self-managed and cloud environments, using infrastructure as code practices
 * Leading source code management and CI/CD migrations to GitLab, including large-scale enterprise moves using Congregate
 * Building repeatable delivery kits, documentation, and enablement materials that help Professional Services and partners deploy and adopt GitLab best practices
 * Lead the full technical delivery lifecycle for GitLab Professional Services engagements, from early scoping and technical discovery through implementation and handoff.
 * Produce high-level and detailed technical designs for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, ensuring deliverables align with customer requirements and expectations.
 * Evaluate and communicate scalability and security considerations (including compliance constraints) in proposed GitLab reference architectures and implementation plans.
 * Deploy and configure GitLab in customer environments, including on-premises and major cloud providers, using Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit (GET) aligned to reference architectures.
 * Plan and execute source system migrations to GitLab using Congregate, partnering closely with customer stakeholders to reduce risk, protect data integrity, and minimize downtime.
 * Provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best-practice guidance, including advising on internal frameworks such as the Delivery Governance Framework (DGF) and GitLab Flow.
 * Coordinate and oversee implementation work across GitLab team members, partners, and customer points of contact (POCs), ensuring clear asynchronous communication and decision capture, effective execution, and high-quality outcomes.
 * Mentor Professional Services and partner consultants by contributing documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and by leading enablement sessions on how to deliver and position service offerings.
 * Maintain and improve delivery automation assets with an emphasis on code cleanliness, maintainability, and appropriate unit/integration testing.
 * Support scoping and Statement of Work (SOW) creation with Professional Services Engagement Managers, stay current on monthly GitLab releases, and help Regional Delivery Managers with technical vetting and staffing assessments while maintaining a 55% billable utilization.
 * Review and provide input to Professional Services training materials and presentations
 * Develop case studies, presentations, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies
 * Work closely with customer project teams to ensure accurate task-level articulation of work required


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions with customers and partners and communicate risks/trade-offs clearly in an asynchronous environment.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Professional Services Technical Architect is part of GitLab's Professional Services organization. We partner with customers who are transitioning to GitLab, expanding how they use an existing GitLab installation, or planning complex upgrades to their infrastructure and processes. Our team brings a diverse set of skills across GitLab deployment, maintenance, and day-to-day usage, along with deep technical knowledge of adjacent tools and platforms. Working closely with Engagement Managers, partner consultants, and customer stakeholders, we focus on delivering high-quality outcomes, sharing best practices, and helping customers realize faster time to value from their GitLab investment. We operate in GitLab's remote, asynchronous environment and rely on clear documentation and transparent communication to collaborate effectively.

This role models skills and behavior aligned with GitLab Values and typically reports to the Regional Delivery Manager. posting.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

THIS IS A REMOTE OPPORTUNITY AND WE WOULD BE INTERESTED IN APPLICANTS FROM CANADA IN EST TIME ZONES ONLY AT THIS TIME. 


SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER, GRAFANA FRONTEND 

THE OPPORTUNITY: 

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing:

 * Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.
 * Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.
 * Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.
 * Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.
 * Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.
 * Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.
 * Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.
 * Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.
 * Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.
 * Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.
 * Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.
 * Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

 * Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.
 * A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.
 * A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.
 * Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.
 * Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.
 * An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.
 * Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. 

BONUS POINTS FOR

 * Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.
 * Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.
 * Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.
 * Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.
 * Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Canada, the Base compensation range for this role is CAD 211,450 - CAD 253,740. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process.

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. 

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

 * 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
 * Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
 * Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
 * Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
 * Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
 * Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
 * Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
 * Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
 * Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
 * In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
 * Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada (EST/CST time zones) 


THE OPPORTUNITY 


ABOUT GRAFANA FRONTEND

The Grafana Frontend group is responsible for the end to end user experience on Grafana the observability product and Grafana the platform used by many engineers to build plugins. Our squads are responsible for dashboards, data visualization and manipulation, navigation across the ecosystem, sharing experience, content search,organisation and more.

You'll also have the opportunity to work across the Grafana Frontend team and partner with other squads within the Grafana department to drive innovation and solve complex engineering challenges.


THE SQUAD: DATAVIZ

We build and evolve the Grafana Visualizations. We want to give our users the ability to visualize their data in a way that’s easy to set up and understand, so they can pull out interesting and valuable insights. 

 

Some of our recent projects include:

 * Externalisation of our core visualization to be independently releasable and remove interdependencies
 * GraphViz: Visualize relationships, flows, and architectures using the Graphviz DOT language with live metrics from any Grafana data source.
 * Raising the bar on quality and reliability: improving our test coverage, introduce a new testing strategy and tooling for visual regressions
 * Refresh the look and feel of our existing visualizations. E.g Table and Gauge

Our work is open source, you can browse grafana/grafana on GitHub directly to see how we build our software. Our stack is primarily Typescript, React, and uPlot and eCharts for our visualisations.


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.


THE OPPORTUNITY

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. We build and operate systems that support Grafana’s business operations and customer experience, working closely with product teams and internal business partners.

The Usage squad works on billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and cloud marketplace integrations. Our software helps customers understand their consumption and costs, and helps internal teams operate accurate, reliable billing processes.

We are looking for a Staff Fullstack Engineer with strong backend experience who enjoys making complex business systems reliable, understandable and easier to operate. You will help deliver new capabilities while improving existing services, reducing repetitive manual work and addressing edge cases that affect customers and internal stakeholders.

This is a hands-on Staff engineering role within the AppCore Usage squad. You will lead complex technical work, contribute directly to implementation and share ownership with the squad’s other Staff and Senior engineers. Your primary focus will be Usage’s systems and outcomes, collaborating with adjacent teams when the work requires it.

Our ownership includes application code, data stores, deployment configuration and the cloud infrastructure supporting our services. You should be comfortable following a problem across those boundaries and making improvements with the appropriate platform teams.

We are remote-first and global. For this role, we prefer candidates in NASA’s Eastern Time zone to provide more overlap with our EMEA colleagues.


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Your initial focus will be approximately 75% backend and 25% frontend. This balance will evolve with the squad’s priorities. You should be comfortable delivering across the stack, from business logic and APIs through to the interfaces customers and internal teams use.

 * Design, build and operate backend services and APIs supporting billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and marketplace workflows.
 * Build and maintain backend services primarily in Go, with Node.js also present in our stack, and contribute to TypeScript/React applications to deliver complete features.
 * Improve the correctness and reliability of billing and usage workflows, including validation, reconciliation, error handling and recovery.
 * Identify recurring manual tasks and replace them with maintainable automation, clear operational workflows and appropriate controls.
 * Maintain and evolve the infrastructure supporting our services, including Kubernetes workloads, scheduled jobs, cloud resources and deployment configuration.
 * Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines to make changes repeatable, reviewable and safe across environments.
 * Investigate production issues across application code, databases and infrastructure, including resource exhaustion, failed jobs, slow queries and replication delays.
 * Plan and execute service deployments, database changes and infrastructure migrations, including validation, monitoring and recovery plans.
 * Build and maintain integrations with cloud marketplaces and external business systems where required by the squad’s work.
 * Deliver projects from understanding requirements and proposing an approach through implementation, testing, rollout and production support.
 * Make changes traceable and testable, supporting audit requirements and clear explanations of system behaviour.
 * Collaborate with product management, Support, DealOps, GTM, infrastructure teams and adjacent AppCore squads to clarify requirements and resolve dependencies.
 * Share technical leadership through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring and practical improvements.
 * Participate in the squad’s on-call rotation after onboarding. Improve dashboards, alert quality, runbooks and recovery procedures, and follow through on incident findings.


WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

You enjoy engineering work where correctness, reliability and business impact matter. You find value in improving an established system, removing a recurring operational problem or making a billing workflow easier to understand and support.

You take ownership from understanding the problem through delivery and production support. You can turn an ambiguous request into manageable increments, make sound trade-offs and follow through without needing each step prescribed. You ask useful questions, seek feedback and raise uncertainty or blockers early.

You adapt as priorities change, learn unfamiliar systems and technologies, and contribute where the squad needs you. You bring a strong backend specialty while remaining willing and able to work on frontend features and supporting infrastructure.

You reason about how a service behaves in production: how it is deployed, where its data lives, what happens when dependencies fail, and how the team detects and recovers from problems.

You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation. In a distributed team, you make decisions, progress and risks visible so colleagues can contribute across time zones. You work independently while staying connected to the squad.

As a Staff engineer, you bring technical depth and sound judgment while remaining close to implementation. You collaborate constructively with other experienced engineers, welcome different perspectives and help the squad reach decisions and move forward.

We embrace thoughtful use of AI-assisted development. We value engineers who use these tools to support exploration, implementation, testing and documentation while taking responsibility for the quality and correctness of the result.


REQUIREMENTS

 * Substantial experience designing, delivering and operating production backend systems, with the depth and judgment to lead complex work hands-on.
 * Strong experience building and operating production backend systems in Go, our primary backend language.
 * Professional experience contributing to frontend applications using TypeScript and React, or comparable technologies, and willingness to work across the stack as priorities change.
 * Experience reasoning about distributed systems, including partial failures, retries, consistency and interactions between services.
 * Experience with relational databases, including data modelling, schema migrations, query performance and safe production changes.
 * Practical experience deploying and troubleshooting containerised services and jobs in Kubernetes.
 * Experience managing cloud infrastructure through code and working with CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration and controlled rollouts.
 * Ability to investigate production problems using logs, metrics and traces, and turn findings into lasting improvements.
 * A record of delivering projects end to end, clarifying requirements, making trade-offs and following through after release.
 * Experience working remotely, with clear asynchronous communication and dependable collaboration across time zones.
 * Ability to learn unfamiliar domains and technologies, adjust your approach as new information emerges, and take ownership beyond your main area of expertise.
 * Experience writing readable, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, maintain and operate.
 * Willingness to participate in on-call and take responsibility for the production behaviour of the systems you build.
 * Experience supporting colleagues through code reviews, mentoring and constructive technical discussions.


BONUS POINTS FOR

 * Usage metering, billing engines, pricing and rates, financial reconciliation or customer-facing cost management applications.
 * Reducing operational toil and automating workflows with recurring exceptions or manual interventions.
 * Systems with auditability, traceability or financial-control requirements.
 * MySQL operations, replication, database upgrades and performance tuning.

posting.title: Senior Manager, Accounting & Finance
posting.description:
Why Thunderbird?

Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At Thunderbird, we build privacy-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data.

We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first.

We are a small but growing company of 70+ people distributed across seven countries. As Thunderbird evolves beyond a single desktop application, we are expanding across desktop, mobile, paid services, and new product experiences that help people and organizations work more effectively without giving up control to big tech ecosystems.

Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s apps freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long-term sustainability and continued innovation.

A note about Thunderbird and Mozilla: Thunderbird Technologies Corporation is the nonprofit-owned company behind Thunderbird email and a growing portfolio of products. While part of the Mozilla family, Thunderbird is a separate entity from Mozilla Corporation and Mozilla Foundation with its own compensation programs, benefits, and employment policies.

To learn more, visit www.thunderbird.net

The opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Accounting & Finance to serve as Thunderbird’s most senior finance professional. The right person will bring a strong accounting or controllership foundation and the breadth to lead financial planning and analysis, finance operations, and organization-level decision support.

As Thunderbird grows across donations, subscription services, enterprise offerings, and international operations, our financial needs are becoming more complex. We need stronger integration across accounting and FP&A, experienced oversight of emerging revenue models and tax obligations, and clear financial analysis that helps leadership understand performance, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Head of Finance will directly manage our Senior Staff Accountant and Senior FP&A Analyst. This is a hands-on functional leadership role for someone who can provide experienced financial judgment, develop an established team, and remain close to the details while helping build the systems, controls, reporting, and finance practices the organization needs for its next stage of growth.

This role requires regular working-hour overlap with the COO, finance team, and other colleagues across North American time zones. Candidates based in Eastern or Central time zones are preferred; candidates elsewhere in the United States should be comfortable maintaining substantial overlap with those working hours. Flexibility for meetings with colleagues, advisers, and affiliated organizations in Europe is also expected.

What you’ll do 

 * Lead Thunderbird’s finance function, with overall responsibility for accounting, financial planning and analysis, tax, treasury, and finance operations.
 * Manage and develop Thunderbird’s finance team, establishing clear priorities, responsibilities, review practices, and accountability.
 * Oversee monthly and annual close, financial reporting, reconciliations, accounting policies, and internal controls.
 * Oversee accounting and revenue recognition across donations, subscriptions, enterprise arrangements, partnerships, and other revenue streams.
 * Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, longer-range financial planning, and scenario analysis.
 * Develop clear management reporting and visualizations that highlight important trends, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions.
 * Oversee tax, audit, indirect tax, VAT/GST, corporate filings, and related work with external advisers.
 * Evaluate the financial, tax, accounting, and operational implications of entering new jurisdictions or establishing additional entities.
 * Work with Enterprise Partnerships and Legal to establish financial reporting, reconciliation, and control processes for partner-led commercial arrangements.
 * Oversee financial reporting to Thunderbird’s parent organization and affiliated Mozilla organizations.
 * Own financial oversight of payroll across multiple providers in partnership with the People team.
 * Document and strengthen finance systems and workflows, including accounting, expense management, payment-platform reconciliation, documentation, and automation.
 * Oversee cash-flow planning, treasury, banking, and investment activities, working closely with the Senior FP&A Analyst.
 * Serve as a trusted finance adviser to organizational leaders, translating complex financial information into clear recommendations.

What you bring 

 * 15+ years of relevant professional experience, including progressively responsible roles spanning accounting, financial planning and analysis, and finance operations.
 * Significant accounting or controllership experience, including responsibility for U.S. GAAP financial reporting, close processes, internal controls, revenue recognition, and complex accounting judgments.
 * 5+ years of people management experience in a finance or accounting environment, including coaching, feedback, prioritization, performance support, career development, and team development.
 * Demonstrated ability to improve budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and financial data visualization and translate complex information into clear insights and recommendations for non-finance leaders.
 * Substantive experience with subscription, SaaS, digital-product, enterprise, or comparable technology-based revenue models.
 * Experience supporting partner-led commercial arrangements, such as reseller, licensing, wholesale, or revenue-sharing models, including evaluating financial terms and developing or overseeing the related reporting, reconciliation, controls, and revenue-recognition processes.
 * Working knowledge of merchant-of-record arrangements, payment platforms, indirect tax, and international VAT/GST requirements.
 * Experience supporting an internationally distributed organization and coordinating financial obligations across multiple jurisdictions.
 * Proven ability to oversee tax, audit, and other external finance requirements and effectively manage outside advisers.
 * Experience providing oversight and review of cash management, treasury, banking, and organizational investment activities, including developing recommendations for senior decision-makers.
 * A track record of strengthening financial systems, workflows, documentation, and controls.
 * Strong judgment and comfort moving between people leadership, detailed financial review, practical hands-on problem-solving, and organization-level decision support.
 * Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to identify and explain financial risks, implications, and tradeoffs.

Bonus points for

 * Experience working within a subsidiary, portfolio, federated, or similarly affiliated organizational structure, including reporting to a parent organization or shareholder.
 * Prior work supporting the establishment of a new legal entity or expansion into a new jurisdiction.
 * Familiarity with Intacct, Ramp, or comparable finance and expense-management systems.
 * Experience in a mission-driven, open-source, nonprofit-affiliated, or similarly values-oriented organization.

About you

You are an experienced finance leader who is equally comfortable reviewing detailed financial work and advising senior leaders. You know that an effective finance function requires accurate reporting, sound controls, integrated planning, clear analysis, and a willingness to surface risks and make recommendations.

You understand the complexity created by multiple revenue models, partner-led commercial arrangements, international operations, and evolving tax and reporting obligations. You can translate those requirements into practical policies, procedures, controls, and operating practices, building them where they do not yet exist and improving them as the organization evolves. You also recognize when external expertise is needed and can provide appropriate rigor without unnecessary complexity.

You are a thoughtful people manager who gives experienced team members direction, oversight, and room to grow. You can distill sophisticated analysis into what matters most for decision-makers and are motivated by building finance capability in a lean, hands-on environment.

Work environment

This is a full-time, fully remote position. You’ll work with colleagues, partners, and customers across multiple countries and time zones, so strong communication and documentation skills are essential.

Availability to participate in required company-wide gatherings and team workweeks, which may involve periodic domestic or international travel.

Compensation & benefits

We benchmark our base salaries to local markets and target the 60th percentile of the peer market. The salary ranges for this role are:

 * US: $165,000 - $190,000 USD

We may consider candidates with strong skills but less than the required experience. Title, level and compensation will be determined based on qualifications and experience.

In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your whole self.

Work & career

 * Fully remote work & schedule flexibility
 * Company-provided laptop
 * Annual bonus program
 * Monthly remote work stipend
 * Annual professional development stipend
 * Access to Coursera learning platform
 * Company all-hands and team gatherings

Rest & play

 * 24 days PTO per year (prorated) 
 * Your birthday
 * Year-end company shutdown
 * 9 wellbeing days 
 * Public holidays
 * Other paid leave
 * Quarterly wellbeing stipend for personal / family activities

Health & family

 * 401(k) contributions
 * Health, dental, & vision insurance
 * Disability insurance
 * Life insurance
 * Employee assistance program 
 * Paid parental leave
 * Paid sick days 

Work eligibility

Applicants must reside in and have permanent work authorization for the country location(s) specified in the posting. We are unable to consider applicants outside of these markets at this time. And, we do not provide visa sponsorship.

How to apply

Please apply directly through our career page. We carefully review every cover letter and screening question, so take the time to answer each fully. We value authentic, thoughtful responses that reflect your own experience and perspective. It is fine to use AI tools to polish your writing, but your answers should be your own. Candidates who submit generic or unoriginal AI-generated responses may be disqualified from further consideration.

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

Thunderbird believes in the value of diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge, and knows diversity, equity and inclusion are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Thunderbird will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose. 

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodations@thunderbird.net to request accommodation.

posting.title: Developer Relations Engineer
posting.locationText: Home Based - APAC; Home based - EMEA
posting.description:
As the publisher of Ubuntu we serve millions of developers, building for the cloud, IoT and data science. We aim to make open source easier and more reliable for innovators and enterprises.

We have created a new Developer Relations team to engage directly with open source communities and developer-centric organisations. We hope both to communicate our vision and products for better open source development experiences, and also to have a better feedback loop from those audiences to shape our offerings and priorities.

A Developer Relations Engineer is a technical expert, strategist and communicator with deep empathy for developers. This discipline combines practical engineering skills with firm diplomacy across organisational boundaries, in both directions. Like our audience, a Developer Relations Engineer is never satisfied with the status quo, and is driven by an insatiable curiosity to find better ways to get things done. They are problem-solvers and inventors, who understand people's needs and love the way that tools can be adapted to meet them. They stay current with tech trends and provide insights and guidance while fostering innovation.

To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical.

Location: we are building our initial DevRel team in Europe, Middle East, African and American time zones


WHAT YOUR DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

In a typical day, a developer relations engineer might:

 * take part in team product meetings, at levels from strategy to day-by-day development progress, contributing insight and expertise
 * maintain conversations with developer community members wherever they may be found - IRC, social media, product forums, meet-ups and more
 * work with colleagues in other teams in the company, as part of efforts to help establish commonality and consistent approaches 
 * help solve specific technical problems that users or colleagues have identified 
 * contribute to technical documentation to ensure that developer users' needs are met there
 * work on technical articles, presentations or workshops 
 * identify new opportunities and directions for improvement in the developer experience we provide
 * present at conferences, meetups or technical events


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR IN YOU

A strong candidate

 * is a programmer or developer with a demonstrable passion for and engagement in open-source software
 * has worked with real-world challenges developing and deploying software using Linux
 * has practical hands-on experience of Linux software packaging (including Snaps, debs, charms, rocks, PIP, containers)
 * understands current software packing issues and trends in the Linux ecosystem 
 * has been a contributor to open-source communities, software and documentation
 * is an engaging, vivacious speaker and presenter
 * can work effectively, tactfully, empathetically and confidently in contexts where different parties have different perspectives, needs and understanding
 * builds trust, relationships and confidence
 * is willing to travel globally twice a year for company events, as well as to upstream and partner events


ADDITIONAL SKILLS THAT YOU MIGHT ALSO BRING

 * previous experience in a developer advocacy or community role
 * in-depth familiarity with Ubuntu and the Canonical ecosystem of products

 


WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

 * Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
 * Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
 * Annual compensation review
 * Recognition rewards
 * Annual holiday leave
 * Maternity and paternity leave
 * Employee Assistance Programme
 * Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
 * Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events


ABOUT CANONICAL

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.


CANONICAL IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. We are hiring junior engineers to work across the breadth of our Ubuntu Engineering organisation -  engineers who care deeply for quality, performance and resilience in software, engineers who are just as comfortable designing and engineering new software as they are packaging, integrating, testing and shipping the incredible catalog of open source software provided by the Ubuntu repositories.

Our engineers integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world’s most deployed open source operating system, it's a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments.

The four key teams that ship Ubuntu are 

 * Foundations: maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities
 * Server: leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution
 * Desktop: driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter
 * Debcrafters: a new team responsible for the forward movement, maintenance and overall health of the Ubuntu archive: one of the most abundant repositories of open source software available today

Bring your existing expertise and learn new skills by working on one of the most prolific pieces of open source software. As an engineer working on Ubuntu you could work on any or all of the following categories:

 * Development: design, build and ship new foundational systems software and applications in Rust, Go, Flutter, and Python
 * Architecture: engineer the integration of open source from boot firmware to cloud applications deployment
 * Packaging: a combination of Debian and Snap packaging to ship software in the distribution
 * Automation: build and maintain the machinery responsible for building, testing and shipping Ubuntu
 * Distro Engineering: the maintenance and evolution of a Linux distribution and its repositories

If you have skills in those areas, or you have other skills you believe could contribute to Ubuntu, and you're keen to get started building your career in open source, then this is the role for you. Our junior career path caters for both new graduates and early careers engineers. 

At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to engage with and contribute to the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community and contribute with enthusiasm and precision to a broad range of technologies.

Location: We have remote roles open in every time zone.


THE ROLE ENTAILS

Based on the first round of interviews, we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit and conduct second-round interviews with those teams. Our engineers are:

 * Designing, building and shipping software in Rust, Go, Python and C/C++
 * Packaging, integrating, testing and uploading open source software to the Ubuntu repositories
 * Debugging issues, then designing and delivering robust solutions
 * Authoring and improving technical and community documentation
 * Contributing to upstream and neighboring open source projects
 * Collaborating as part of a globally distributed team
 * Continuously learning and progressing their technical and professional skills


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR IN YOU

 * An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
 * Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
 * Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations
 * A passion for open source software
 * Experience with Rust, Go, Python, Flutter or C/C++
 * Professional written and spoken English
 * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 * Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each


NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS

 * Familiarity with Linux distributions
 * Familiarity with system debugging tools and techniques

 * Experience contributing to open source projects


WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

ABOUT CANONICAL

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.


CANONICAL IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

posting.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


AN OVERVIEW OF THIS ROLE

As a Senior Backend Engineer with the Database Excellence group, you'll build and evolve the data frameworks and tooling that keep GitLab's application datastores scalable, healthy, and safe across both GitLab.com and thousands of self-managed instances. A primary focus for this role is building proactive data growth controls for GitLab.com, including retention and lifecycle management frameworks, enforcement of retention policies at schema-change time, and tooling that keeps database growth sustainable as AI-driven development accelerates how quickly data accumulates. You'll help teams across GitLab reason confidently about data architecture, placement, and lifecycle management, while proactively identifying saturation points in our GitLab.com infrastructure and driving corrective actions with partner teams. With the team's recent move into the Data Engineering organization, you'll also shape new scalability and data health features for self-managed customers, working hands-on with PostgreSQL and Ruby on Rails in a fully remote, highly collaborative environment.

Some examples of our projects:

 * Data Growth Controls (retention enforcement and data lifecycle management)
 * SQL Traffic Replay Tooling
 * Background Operations Framework


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 * Develop and iterate backend features and data frameworks that make it safe and efficient for GitLab teams to work with data at scale across SaaS and self-managed deployments.
 * Design and build data retention and lifecycle management frameworks, including retention policy enforcement, bulk data removal tooling, and automated identification of tables that need retention policies.
 * Build shift-left guardrails, such as static analysis checks and schema-change-time enforcement, that catch unsustainable data growth patterns before they reach production.
 * Collaborate closely with product management, UX, frontend, infrastructure, software delivery, and analytics teams to design and ship high-performing solutions
 * Review and improve database-related changes from other engineers and community contributors, ensuring data integrity, safety, and performance across all deployment scenarios.
 * Design, build, and maintain tooling such as SQL traffic replay and background operations frameworks to proactively surface and address scalability and performance issues.
 * Research, design, and implement improvements to data retention and lifecycle management, database performance, scalability, and data health, including areas like soft delete strategies and database migration testing.
 * Document database best practices, patterns to avoid, and data architecture guidance to enable developers to make informed decisions.
 * Develop proactive tooling and guardrails that help developers detect and remediate potential performance and data issues early in the development lifecycle.
 *  


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 * Professional software engineering experience working with PostgreSQL in large, complex production environments, including high availability solutions with automatic failover and zero-downtime data migrations as well as managing large or fast-growing datasets through approaches such as data retention, archiving, partitioning, or lifecycle management.
 * Proficiency with Ruby on Rails or another Ruby framework, including designing, implementing, and reviewing backend features.
 * Ability to reason about software design, algorithms, and performance trade-offs at a system level.
 * Strong written communication skills and comfort working asynchronously in an all-remote, distributed team.
 * Self-directed work style with effective organizational skills and the ability to manage priorities as a "manager of one".
 * Alignment with GitLab's values, including transparency, collaboration, inclusion, and contribution to open source.
 * Openness to learning and applying new tools and approaches, including transferable experience from related data, infrastructure, or developer tooling domains.
 * Willingness to participate in our tier 2 dabase on-call rotation in your time zone.

The Database Excellence Group is a remote, agile backend team that builds and maintains the frameworks, patterns, and tooling that enable GitLab teams to work confidently with data at scale across all application datastores. As part of the broader Data Engineering organization, we focus on data scalability, health, and developer enablement for both GitLab.com and thousands of self-managed deployments, collaborating closely with infrastructure, software delivery, and analytics stages to ensure data changes are safe, performant, and compatible across diverse environments. We are independent, self-organized contributors, and we collaborate asynchronously across regions. We are currently expanding our mission from proactively identifying and addressing saturation points in GitLab.com infrastructure to also delivering scalability features and data health initiatives to self-managed customers.

HOW GITLAB SUPPORTS FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 * Growth and Development Fund

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

posting.description:
We're building a new product team in India to help shape how customers build, deploy, and operate AI applications on MongoDB. This is an early hire on a growing team—you'll join while the team is still taking shape, with the opportunity to have real impact from the start.

You'll report to a Director of Product Management based in Europe, working async-first with partners across India, EMEA, and North America. The engineering team in India is being built in parallel, so you'll be working closely with engineers from the early days of the team.

We are looking to speak to candidates based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You'll be the end-to-end owner for a core area of our AI application platform—from discovery and vision through roadmap, delivery, and iteration. This is a senior individual contributor role where you lead through ownership, expertise, and cross-functional influence.

Day to day, that means

 * Defining product strategy and roadmap for your area, aligned with MongoDB's broader AI strategy and business goals
 * Talking to customers — from AI-native startups to large enterprises — to understand how they build and deploy AI applications, where they struggle, and what MongoDB should do about it
 * Writing clear product narratives, memos, and specs that align stakeholders, clarify trade-offs, to guide conversations with engineering, design, product marketing, etc
 * Partnering with cross-functional stakeholders—including Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Partners, Sales, and Developer Relations—to scope, prioritize, and ship, balancing experimentation with reliability and scale, and driving positioning, launches, and enablement
 * Identifying new opportunities autonomously—spotting gaps, shaping problem spaces, researching industry trends and running discovery sessions with customers
 * Define and own clear success metrics for your area and use them to prioritize, make trade-offs and communicate impact

You'll develop deep expertise in how companies build AI applications — including agentic workflows, retrieval and memory, evaluation, observability, and deployment patterns.


HOW WE WORK

 * Async-first. Documentation and written communication are how decisions travel across time zones
 * Sync when it makes sense. When we need to discuss something live, we hop on a call to unbundle issues together.
 * In-person when it matters. The team gets together periodically for planning, relationship-building, and the kind of work that's better done face to face


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 * 5+ years in product management (or equivalent) building platforms, infrastructure, or developer-facing products — ideally in cloud, data, or AI
 * Proven end-to-end ownership of a product area: from framing the problem and vision through roadmap, execution, launch, and iteration
 * Customer obsession: you're comfortable running discovery calls, digging into workflows, and turning messy feedback into clear product decisions
 * Strong written and live communication: clear docs, productive meetings, confident stakeholder presentations. This matters more in an async, distributed team — writing is how you lead
 * Technical depth sufficient to collaborate with senior engineers on distributed systems, cloud services, and AI/ML tooling, and to ask good questions when something is unclear
 * Curiosity about AI: you follow how companies are building AI applications — agents, orchestration frameworks, RAG, fine-tuning, or other emerging patterns
 * Comfort with ambiguity: you help define the problem, the success metrics, and the path forward. In an early-stage team, this is the job


BONUS POINTS

 * Experience building developer tools, AI platforms, or MLOps/LLMOps products
 * Engineering background or deep experience partnering with engineering on technical products
 * Experience with enterprise customers on mission-critical workloads
 * Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Figma Make) to move faster and amplify impact


HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS (30/60/90 DAYS)

We need someone who can onboard quickly and start driving impact early.

In your first 30 days, you will:

 * Ramp up on MongoDB products, AI application patterns, and how our teams work
 * Shadow customer calls and internal forums to learn current strategy, open questions, and key stakeholders
 * Produce a clear written overview of your product area: current state, key bets, and known gaps

By 60 days, you will

 * Take ownership of a set of customer relationships and run your own discovery conversations each week
 * Own and socialize an initial strategy and roadmap proposal for your area, with clear problem statements and success metrics
 * Partner with engineering and design to shape and drive at least one scoped initiative into execution

By 90 days, you will

 * Be the go-to owner for your product area, driving prioritization and day-to-day decision-making across functions
 * Lead customer- and data-informed iterations on what you’ve shipped, adjusting the roadmap based on what you’re learning
 * Contribute to the broader AI application platform strategy with perspectives from your domain, customers, and the field


WHY THIS ROLE

MongoDB is one of the most widely adopted database platforms in the world, used by tens of thousands of customers — including much of the Fortune 100 and a fast-growing set of AI-native startups. Our cloud platform, Atlas, runs across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.

This role puts you at the center of how MongoDB powers AI applications at scale. You’ll own a critical slice of that story, from strategy through delivery and adoption.


ABOUT MONGODB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

posting.title: Staff Product Manager, Atlas Infinite
posting.locationText: Alberta; British Columbia; Manitoba; Nova Scotia; Ontario; Quebec
posting.description:
The Staff Product Manager is an Individual Contributor (IC) product leader responsible for a broad platform surface for Atlas Infinite at MongoDB. Atlas Infinite is the largest architectural innovation in MongoDB Atlas ever, purpose-built to handle today's speed and scale of development and demand. 

In this position, you will own and solve end-to-end problems around the user experience and database experience of Atlas Infinite, including but limited to feature discovery, activation, monetization, and retention. You will see patterns, opportunities, and risks across areas, own cross-team product and architectural trade-offs, establish reusable standards for PM craft, and align senior stakeholders around multi-year bets. You have deep knowledge of cloud database platforms, distributed data systems, and enterprise product development.

You will partner closely with cross-functional engineering leaders, product peers, and executive stakeholders to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries, guiding a portfolio spanning Atlas Infinite's disaggregated compute and storage architecture, production workload readiness, migration and Atlas interoperability, and the new customer experiences this architecture may make possible. You will not inherit a closed list of future features: part of your mandate is to discover opportunities we have not yet articulated and challenge assumptions about which problems matter most. With AWS public preview now live, you will help turn real workload evidence into a credible path to GA and subsequent releases, in close partnership with the existing team.

This role can be based out of a MongoDB office or remotely in Canada.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Interlinked Vision & Multi-Year Bets: Set and champion a product vision across Atlas Infinite's capabilities, while actively discovering opportunities that are not on today's roadmap or fit any single team's remit. Explore what decoupled compute and storage could make possible for developers, enterprises, and emerging AI workloads; use hypotheses, customer evidence, prototypes, and market signals to uncover needs we have not yet named. Branching, on-demand compute, and instant recovery are examples of possible bets. Make the case for investment and prioritization, including build-vs-buy considerations, and distinguish exploratory vision from release commitments
 * Cross-Team Execution: Along with program management, own execution health across workstreams, negotiating sequencing, scope, and resource trade-offs with engineering leaders and peer PMs where you have no direct authority. Ensure preview-to-GA readiness, roadmaps, and dependencies across database, storage, Atlas platform, migration, backup, security, and cloud infrastructure teams are aligned and connect to company objectives
 * Execution & Research Standards: Establish lightweight operating practices and shared customer/market research frameworks that make workload qualification, customer-representative testing, win/loss analysis, launch readiness, and post-launch learning consistent across the portfolio. Use data to drive decisions without overburdening delivery teams
 * Product Health: Resolve complex post-launch escalations when the root cause spans architecture, performance, migration, observability, supportability, or unclear ownership. Turn customer and operational signals into systemic product fixes rather than one-off workarounds
 * Customer Discovery: Identify needs and competitive dynamics that cut across product areas. Look beyond requests from today's customers to discover emerging jobs-to-be-done, surprising uses of the architecture, and reasons customers do not choose MongoDB at all. Combine interviews, workload and pricing evidence, product analytics, field feedback, and experiments to test known hypotheses and uncover unknowns; reorient the roadmap when the evidence warrants it
 * Outbound & GTM: Partner with product marketing, pricing, sales, solutions architecture, customer success, documentation, and support on high-stakes customer engagements, product positioning, and omni-channel marketing. Establish ideal customer profile; ensure claims and migration guidance match demonstrated capabilities; translate successful adoption and enablement approaches into shared playbooks
 * Executive Alignment: Synthesize customer experience, technical readiness, adoption, and commercial impact into clear, confident product stories for senior leadership. Surface cross-area risks and progress early, including trade-offs between new-workload growth, customer savings, and changes to existing Atlas usage
 * Mentorship: Mentor PMs across the area, sharing frameworks for cross-team alignment, customer evidence, technical trade-offs, multi-year bets, and leadership communication


QUALIFICATIONS

 * 8+ years of product management or equivalent product leadership experience, with a track record personally shaping strategy and outcomes for complex technical platforms across multiple teams, rather than only coordinating delivery
 * Strong technical fluency in cloud databases, distributed data systems, storage infrastructure, developer experiences, or an adjacent developer platform. Able to reason with engineers about architecture, performance, availability, data movement, and trade-offs without needing to be the system designer
 * A demonstrated ability to discover opportunities beyond the current roadmap: connect technical possibilities to unmet customer needs, formulate and test hypotheses, notice surprising patterns, and change direction when evidence challenges the original thesis
 * Experience taking a complex product from early adoption toward dependable, broader use while protecting space for longer-term innovation; able to make explicit trade-offs among customer trust, technical readiness, speed, and investment
 * Proven ability to influence without authority, negotiating sequencing and resource trade-offs across partner teams with competing priorities
 * Commercial and analytical judgment: able to assess workload-level value, adoption and usage evidence, competitive alternatives, pricing and unit economics, and the impact of a new product on an existing portfolio. Comfortable with build-vs-buy questions where relevant
 * Ability to raise the quality of customer discovery and product decision-making across teams through useful shared methods and mentorship, without mistaking more process for better outcomes
 * Exceptional communication skills: able to explain a technical and commercial thesis, its uncertainties, and the evidence that would change your mind to engineers, customers, executives, and go-to-market partners


SUCCESS MEASURES

 * In 3 months you will have built a shared picture of which workloads Atlas Infinite serves well today, where customers struggle, what must be true for broader adoption, and what remains unknown. You will have clarified ownership with peer PMs and engineering, established baseline measures, and identified the highest-value questions to investigate
 * In 6 months you will have influenced consequential roadmap and GA-readiness decisions with customer-representative evidence; articulated a compelling, revisable view of where Infinite can create distinctive customer value beyond GA; and built a learning agenda with clear tests and decision points for both known bets and newly emerging opportunities
 * In 12 months the portfolio will show measurable progress against its established baselines for qualified adoption, customer experience, and readiness for broader workloads. Important bets will have advanced, changed, or been stopped for explicit reasons; cross-team investments will have produced customer value; and the team will be better equipped to recognize and act on opportunities that were not visible at the start of the year

posting.description:
SOBRE O GRUPO QUINTOANDAR

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal, reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões.

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

LOCALIZAÇÃO E MODELO DE TRABALHO

Nosso time de Canais Críticos (CSI) trabalha com o modelo “híbrido”, sendo necessário estar presencialmente no escritório, localizado na Vila Leopoldina, SP, 2 vezes por semana.


SOBRE A ÁREA E O DESAFIO

A área de Canais Críticos (CSI) é responsável pela proteção reputacional e pela mediação de conflitos de alta complexidade no Grupo QuintoAndar.
Atuando como uma estrutura de terceiro nível (escalados), nosso time trata demandas de extrema sensibilidade que exigem uma investigação profunda da jornada do cliente para desatar nós operacionais e propor soluções definitivas.
Os times para os quais temos oportunidades estão divididos em: o time de Casos Especiais (focado em situações de alta delicadeza e risco, como incidentes graves, incêndios e casos criminais) e o time de Subsídios (focado no relacionamento com escritórios jurídicos, processos cíveis e demandas regulatórias em canais reputacionais/governamentais como Procon e Consumidor.gov).
Trabalhar aqui significa transformar cenários sob pressão em experiências de atendimento humanizadas, empáticas e resolutivas, garantindo a excelência do morar bem.

NOSSOS TIMES DE CANAIS CRÍTICOS - CSI

Times (Procon / ConsumidorGOV / Cível):
Modelo 5x2 (Segunda a sexta-feira, com compensação de horas)

Times (Mídias / Casos Especiais / Conta Comigo)
Modelo 6x1 (Escala de revezamento aos sábados)
Quando possui escala aos sábados, horário das 09:00 às 19:00.
Quando não possui escala aos sábados, horário reduzido na semana das 09:00 às 17:53).

SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES

 * Realizar a gestão end-to-end e a resolução de tickets complexos de terceiro nível, divididos entre os times de Casos Especiais (casos delicados/críticos) e Subsídios (Procon, Consumidor.gov, GOV e processos cíveis).
 * Conduzir análises investigativas profundas nos sistemas internos para compreender a causa-raiz dos problemas e propor soluções justas e definitivas.
 * Efetuar contato telefônico ativo com tom resolutivo, empatia, posicionamento firme e jogo de cintura para negociar acordos.
 * Subsidiar o time Jurídico com defesas técnicas coesas e dados detalhados para instrução de processos cíveis e órgãos reguladores.
 * Atuar ativamente em dinâmicas de atendimento visando garantir a qualidade das tratativas e a sustentabilidade das operações.
 * Gerenciar o backlog diário com rigor técnico, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos rígidos de órgãos governamentais e minimizando reaberturas.
 * Colaborar com os especialistas do time na identificação de gargalos operacionais e na execução de planos de ação para melhoria de processos.

O QUE BUSCAMOS (REQUISITOS)

 * Experiência sólida e consolidada no atendimento a clientes em esferas de alta complexidade ou mediação de conflitos (Reclame Aqui, Procon, Consumidor.gov, Mídias Sociais ou Ouvidoria/Escalados).
 * Perfil analítico e autonomia para interpretar cenários densos, avaliar históricos operacionais e tomar decisões seguras sob pressão.
 * Excelente comunicação verbal e proatividade para realização de negociações telefônicas ativas com alto poder de persuasão.
 * Elevada resiliência e inteligência emocional no tratamento de casos críticos e tratativa com clientes insatisfeitos.
 * Vivência prévia no segmento de suporte a situações críticas e delicadas ou interface com escritórios de advocacia/demandas jurídicas (Diferencial).
 * Familiaridade com o uso de indicadores operacionais de CX e qualidade de atendimento (Diferencial).
 * Residência na Grande São Paulo ou Região Metropolitana para atuação presencial semanal no escritório.

COMO É NOSSO PROCESSO SELETIVO?

Desenhamos uma jornada transparente, direta e focada em avaliar seu potencial técnico, comportamental e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e trilhas de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:

 * Triagem;

 * Entrevista com Stakeholder;
 * Offer o/


Importante: Avaliamos todas as candidaturas individualmente e garantimos retorno para todas as pessoas. Toda a comunicação é feita por e-mail, então certifique-se de liberar o domínio @quintoandar.com.br na sua caixa de entrada.

BENEFÍCIOS 


Oferecemos um pacote completo focado na sua saúde, bem-estar, família e desenvolvimento:

 * Saúde e Bem-Estar: Plano de Saúde, Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Wellhub (Gympass) e QuintoCare (apoio psicológico, jurídico, social e financeiro gratuito).
 * Qualidade de Vida: Vale Refeição e Alimentação, Day Off de aniversário, Dia das Mães e Dia dos Pais.

Actuamos como socios estratégicos del liderazgo, respaldando decisiones críticas mediante una planificación estructurada, análisis avanzados y una sólida gobernanza de resultados, riesgos y oportunidades.

 * De lo macro a lo micro: Co-liderar junto al líder de la BU (Unidad de Negocio) las discusiones de estrategia y planificación a largo plazo. Traducir esa visión en planes a mediano y corto plazo, orquestando desde los procesos de proyección a 8 trimestres vista hasta el proceso de presupuesto (budget) y el seguimiento mensual de riesgos y oportunidades.

Valoramos la diversidad y queremos que todas las personas se sientan bienvenidas aquí, independientemente de su edad, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, etnia, origen, discapacidad, religión o cualquier otra característica. ¡Todas nuestras vacantes están abiertas para todas las personas! Verá que hay algunas preguntas sobre diversidad en el formulario de inscripción.
