posting.title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Head of Credit
posting.description:
ABOUT GRUPO QUINTOANDAR

We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest housing platform in Latin America. Driven by our shared purpose of helping people love where they live, we build technology and solutions that simplify the entire housing journey, from renting to buying and selling.

Operating across 6 countries (Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Peru, Ecuador, and Panama) and with a technology hub in Portugal, we bring together more than 3,100 people united by the challenge of transforming the real estate industry. Backed by top global investors such as SoftBank, General Atlantic, and Kaszek, we have raised over US$ 755 million and are valued at US$ 5.1 billion.

We lead market transformation as pioneers in large-scale Artificial Intelligence applications for the real estate sector. Our platforms welcome over 50 million monthly visits, managing more than 350,000 active rental contracts and processing R$ 20 billion in annual transaction value.

If you are looking to solve complex problems with autonomy, cutting-edge technology, and massive scale impact, come on in, the house is yours.

To learn more about our story, visit: https://grupoquintoandar.com/

 

LOCATION & WORK MODEL

Our Credit team works in a hybrid model, combining remote work flexibility with in-person collaboration at our São Paulo office, one week a month.

 

About the role 

Reports to the Credit Director. Owns the credit policy and pricing for QuintoAndar's financial products, both current (like rent anticipation) and those we are about to launch in our ecosystem. This is a unique opportunity to build and lead a highly senior, "AI First" credit structure. You will have the autonomy to design strategies that function less like a traditional bank and more like a data science environment, fostering a horizontal and hands-on culture.

What this person will do

 * Lead the design and evolution of credit policies and pricing for financial products, starting as an individual contributor and building a robust team of senior specialists.
 * Operate within a marketplace ecosystem, offering credit solutions that solve real needs for our existing clients (e.g., landlords and tenants), creating a virtuous cycle rather than standard open-market prospecting.
 * Structure the team's experimentation agenda (hypothesis, test design, holdout, reading results) ensuring decisions are rigorously backed by data and close to data science practices.
 * Identify where AI can improve policies, pricing, or processes, validating and implementing these innovations to scale our financial products.
 * Act as Credit's main point of contact with Data, Product & Tech (P&T), Treasury, Strategy, and Growth, ensuring seamless product launches and alignment.
 * Maintain the health of our ecosystem by balancing profitability with customer retention, avoiding abusive interest rates and keeping clients active in the QuintoAndar platform.

What we're looking for

 * Solid and proven experience in credit risk, having navigated through roles involving policy, modeling, pricing, or portfolio management.
 * Experience managing specific credit products such as personal loans or working capital.
 * A strong analytical bar and a genuine curiosity for AI and new technological techniques.
 * An owner's mindset and a hands-on approach. Familiarity with tools like Python, GitHub, Airflow, or Databricks is considered a strong plus.
 * Knowledge of banking regulations (such as IFRS 9 and BCB 4966).
 * Proven ability to manage stakeholders across different areas (technical and business) and build structures from the ground up.
 * Bonus: A career path that ideally blends the solid risk foundations of an incumbent bank with the fast-paced, generalist agility of a fintech or digital bank.

 

WHAT IS OUR SELECTION PROCESS LIKE?

We designed a transparent and straightforward journey focused on evaluating your technical and behavioral potential, while giving you the opportunity to get to know our teams and career paths:

 1. Application and Profile Review

 2. Initial Recruiter Conversation

 3. Hiring Manager interview

 4. Technical Assessment 

 5. Stakeholders Interview

 6. Reference Check

 7. Offer & Welcome!

Important: We review all applications individually and guarantee feedback for every candidate. All communication is conducted via email, so please make sure to allow emails from @quintoandar.com.br in your inbox.

 

BENEFITS

We offer a comprehensive package designed to support your health, well-being, family, and professional growth:

 * Compensation: Competitive salary, PLR (Annual Performance Bonus - for eligible roles), and Variable Compensation (for eligible roles).

 * Health & Well-Being: Health Plan, Dental Plan, Life Insurance, Wellhub (Gympass), and QuintoCare (free psychological, legal, social, and financial support).

 * Quality of Life: Meal and Food Vouchers, Birthday Day Off, Mother's Day, and Father's Day.

 * Flexibility: Home Office Allowance and the Work From Anywhere (WFA) program.

 * Family & Care: Childcare Allowance, Atypical Parenting Allowance, Extended Parental Leave, and Kit Leiturinha (children's book club).

 * Education & Career: Partnerships and discounts with educational institutions.

 


Diversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndar

We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals!

You'll notice there are some diversity questions in the application form. For affirmative action roles, this information may be used to verify your alignment with the target audience for the opportunity. In such cases, it may be used for elimination purposes. For non-affirmative action roles, this data will be used anonymously, exclusively to monitor and improve our inclusion practices in the hiring process, and will have no impact on your application.



Privacy and Data Protection

The Grupo QuintoAndar operates in compliance with privacy and data protection laws, including, but not limited to, the Brazilian General Personal Data Protection Law (LGPD) (Law No. 13,709/2018), and ensures the security of your data. To learn more, please access our Privacy Notice for Candidates. For questions or to exercise your rights as a data subject, please contact us through our Service Channel.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in technology, contract management, advanced English and Spanish expertise, and the ability to balance legal risk with business priorities.  

In this role, you will:



 * Review, draft, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements (customer, partnership, SaaS, NDAs, MSAs) in Portuguese and Spanish.
 * Develop and update the company's contract structure in online sign-through agreements, facilitating product adoption and reducing friction.
 * Get involved in strategic cross-border projects within all regions where VTEX operates, including LATAM, North America, EMEA and APAC.
 * Build contractual framework over cutting-edge technology matters, such as Artificial Intelligence, Retail Media, and SaaS solutuons.
 * Implement AI solutions to streamline contract workflows and reduce deal closure time.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. 

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.


PRODUCT AT BREX

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We align cross-functional teams—including Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design—on key decisions, set strategy, and drive products from inception to launch.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Embedded is one of Brex’s fastest-growing enterprise channels, bringing our card program into the financial software and workflows customers already trust. As Staff Product Manager, you will lead its next phase.

What began as a project is now a line of business. You will build the Embedded API and partner platform to unlock 10x growth, accelerate partner launches, and expand the financial capabilities available across the ecosystem.

This is a broad, commercially accountable Staff IC role across Product, Card Infrastructure, APIs, and Business Development. You will lead partner discovery and pitches, shape technical and commercial commitments, convert partner needs into reusable capabilities, and own outcomes through launch, adoption, payment volume, and revenue.


WHERE YOU’LL WORK

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!


RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Own the multi-year strategy for the Embedded API and partner platform.
 * Prioritize the partner segments, workflows, and financial capabilities where Brex can win.
 * Lead partner discovery, executive pitches, solution design, and technical planning.
 * Turn partner needs into reusable APIs, tooling, and integration patterns rather than bespoke solutions.
 * Align Card Infrastructure, API Engineering, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Business Development, and GTM around reliable, scalable launches.
 * Use AI to simplify the developer experience and shorten the path from discovery to production.
 * Make disciplined tradeoffs about what to commit to, defer, standardize, or decline.
 * Own integration speed, reliability, launch rate, payment volume, revenue, and partner expansion.


REQUIREMENTS

 * A track record of scaling an API product, developer platform, or API-led business.
 * Strong judgment about developer experience and reliable, secure integrations.
 * Technical fluency in APIs, data models, distributed or financial systems, and architecture tradeoffs.
 * Credibility in partner discovery, executive pitches, and solution planning.
 * Commercial judgment that connects product roadmaps to adoption, payment volume, and revenue.
 * A founder or GM mindset that moves from ambiguous strategy to launch-level detail.
 * Exceptional communication and influence across technical, business, risk, compliance, and external teams.
 * Fintech, payments, issuing, or embedded-finance experience is preferred but not required.


COMPENSATION

The expected salary range for this role is $280,000 - $350,000.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Radar helps businesses prevent fraud and abuse without getting in the way of legitimate customers. We combine machine learning powered by Stripe’s global network with intuitive dashboard experiences and developer APIs, to give our users comprehensive controls and insights to protect their business against threats ranging from payment fraud and card testing to bot and free trial abuse. 

Fraud doesn’t stand still, and it isn’t limited to checkout. As businesses launch new products and business models, attackers find new ways to exploit them. We obsess about understanding those attacks, identifying defenses that work, and making sophisticated fraud prevention simple for the businesses that depend on us to help them protect and grow their revenue with confidence.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a product manager on the Radar team, you’ll help customers, developers, and partners bring fraud prevention naturally into the systems and workflows they rely on. You’ll shape products that make fraud management feel effortless, connecting Radar’s capabilities to the tools and experiences our users build and run.

You’ll work at the intersection of customer needs and commercial opportunities to shape what we build and how we bring it to market. Working closely with engineering, data science, design, and go-to-market teams, you’ll build products and relationships that deliver lasting value to customers and partners. You’ll connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes while maintaining a high bar for reliability, craft, and the details that make complex products feel simple.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Develop a deep understanding of the payments and fraud landscape, how businesses manage risk, and the systems and workflows they rely on.
 * Work directly with customers, developers, and partners to uncover unmet needs, understand integration challenges, and identify opportunities to build broadly useful products.
 * Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and roadmap, prioritizing opportunities based on user impact, technical feasibility, and business value.
 * Partner closely with engineering and data science to turn sophisticated fraud control and monitoring capabilities into reliable APIs, intuitive tools, and well-crafted developer experiences.
 * Drive product development from ideation through launch, setting the pace, scoping thoughtfully, prioritizing ruthlessly, and executing with rigor.
 * Collaborate deeply with sales, marketing, and partnerships teams to identify opportunities, validate demand, and drive the adoption of new experiences.
 * Work with customers and partners through early implementations, using hands-on feedback to improve documentation, onboarding, and the path from initial evaluation to production use.
 * Own metrics for integration success, adoption, retention, revenue, and user value; use results to guide product and commercial decisions and communicate progress.
 * Communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders about priorities, trade-offs, progress, and results, building alignment across teams you don’t directly manage.


WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 * 8+ years of Product Management experience
 * Highly analytical, with a rigorous approach to quantitative and qualitative evidence. You’re comfortable digging into data, writing SQL when needed, and connecting product decisions to user and business outcomes.
 * Scrappy and resourceful, with experience taking products from zero to one. You thrive in early-stage environments, test ideas quickly, and turn what you learn into products that scale.
 * Strong commercial and business acumen. You understand how customer needs, market dynamics, and product differentiation translate into adoption and durable business value.
 * Proven cross-functional leadership, including experience partnering with B2B sales teams on customer discovery, technical evaluation, and commercialization.
 * Experience shipping Dashboard and API products, with empathy for end users and developers alike. 
 * Experience developing pricing and monetization models for B2B products.
 * Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on APIs, system architecture, and integration trade-offs, and to explain those decisions clearly to customers.
 * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for distilling complex user problems into precise, actionable framing.
 * An ownership mindset and a high bar for product quality. You do what it takes to solve user problems and care deeply about the details of the experience.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 * Experience building fraud prevention, risk, security, or ML powered products.
 * Experience building developer platforms and working with integration partners, including navigating technical dependencies and high-stakes external relationships.

posting.description:

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.


ABOUT THE TEAM

In this role, you would join Stripe's Vulnerability Management team, whose mission is to "Surface vulnerabilities at scale across Stripe." Our vision is to create a culture of continuous excellence in managing vulnerabilities. We want to enhance customer trust by giving users context about threats and vulnerabilities affecting Stripe's systems. We aim to be a key partner in Stripe's risk management by providing visibility into vulnerabilities across Stripe's products and services.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Software Engineer focused on Vulnerability Management at Stripe, you will use your software engineering expertise to find and prioritize vulnerabilities in our systems. Working closely with engineers across the company, you will drive the timely remediation of discovered vulnerabilities, playing a key role in Stripe's overall security and risk strategy.

In addition, you will continuously improve Stripe's security defenses by enhancing our vulnerability management processes and selecting effective scanning tools to uncover weaknesses.

Your core responsibilities as a Vulnerability Management Software Engineer will involve building data- and agent-backed systems to surface vulnerabilities across Stripe. In addition, you will coordinate fixes to prevent exploits that could impact Stripe or our users and serve as an advisor on security risks. All of this requires collaborating cross-functionally to advocate for practices that strengthen the safety of Stripe's systems and data.


WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Identify vulnerabilities using automated tools and triage them appropriately
 * Collaborate with other teams to drive remediation of vulnerabilities
 * Contribute to our overall security and risk management strategy
 * Continuously improve our security posture, processes, and tools


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 * 2+ years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops)
 * Software engineering experience within the security domain
 * Empathy, strong communication skills and a deep respect for the power of collaboration
 * Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
 * High standards for code quality and a constructive attitude to help others raise the bar


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 * An ability to think creatively and holistically about reducing risk in a complex environment
 * Familiarity with automated vulnerability identification tools and triage
 * Delivery of successful projects using agents to automate human review processes

By joining our team, you will have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach, securely.

posting.title: Technical Account Manager 3
posting.description:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Technical Account Manager 

About the job

Twilio is looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager who is going to be the designated technical support engineering contact for our strategic customers. As a designated TAM you will be supporting customers during Pacific hours (8am to 5pm PT) and working on the cases created by customers and resolving complex technical problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences. You should have an interest in digging deep as well as be able to zoom out and look at the larger picture. The TAM delivers proactive guidance to the customer to provide added value through the use of Twilio technologies and deliver recommendations to make the customer’s environment less susceptible to business impacting downtime. You are able to remain calm and effective at higher workloads as well as excelling at prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency. There will also be the potential need to volunteer for holiday coverage on a stipend basis.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

 * Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
 * Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve complex problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.
 * Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack as well as filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs.
 * Understanding customer trends, analyzing patterns, driving betterments and reporting what you observe to the management team in order to better improve our support process is a key part of the role. 

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

 

*Required:

 * 4 to 6+ years of relevant experience
 * Good knowledge of RESTful technology, previous work with APIs and ability to understand and troubleshoot issues with cloud solutions.
 * Broad capabilities to troubleshoot server-side code (Java, Node.js, PHP, C#, Python) and client-side JavaScript, with a good understanding of React and Redux
 * Development experience in a scripting language (REACT, Node.js, Javascript, Python) 
 * Skilled in troubleshooting network connectivity issues, with an understanding of TCP/UDP, and basics of SSL/TLS.
 * High competency in communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences via phone or email mediums
 * Comfortable in working with customers’ developers to troubleshoot use of the Twilio helper libraries. 
 * Have an inquisitive mind to understand how things work
 * Advanced time management skills, ability to work well under pressure, and proficiency at developing workflows to increase troubleshooting efficiency while still following standard processes and procedures.
 * Excellence in task prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency.
 * Interest in utilizing customer feedback to identify and drive improvements in our products.
 * Enthusiasm for interacting and collaborating with other departments within Twilio in your search for the solutions our customers need.
 * Ability to stand in the customer’s shoes and demonstrated dedication to the customer experience.
 * Experience in managing dedicated customer accounts.

 

Desired:

 * Understanding of Telecoms and VOIP including WebRTC and SIP 

Location

This role will be remote and based in Bogota, Colombia, providing support during 9am to 6pm US Central Time 

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

posting.description:

WHAT IS THE ROLE

This is a hands-on build role that will develop and maintain HR's data pipelines on our GCP/BigQuery/dbt data model, with an AI-powered analytics layer on top. Core platform infrastructure is provisioned centrally; you'll help configure HR-specific pipelines and dbt modeling work on top of it, in partnership with our data scientist, and stand up recruiting reporting and insights as the first production use case on the new stack. This role reports directly to the Director of HR Analytics, with high visibility into architecture and stakeholder-facing decisions from day one.

Your mission is to move the organization away from manual reporting and toward a mature, self-service environment where senior stakeholders get decision-ready answers, not just data.

BUILD AND DEPLOY SCALABLE ANALYTICS

 * Build and maintain data pipelines in BigQuery/dbt, on infrastructure provisioned by the central data platform team, that link HR data across the employee lifecycle (Workday, Greenhouse, Qualtrics, ServiceNow), so we can trace how hiring decisions affect long-term engagement and retention.
 * Support and enhance the AI-powered analytics user experience.
 * Develop scalable, self-service dashboards that reduce time spent on reactive, one-off data requests.
 * Implement data governance practices (access controls, validation, documentation) in line with team standards for sensitive HR and compensation data.
 * Build data proficiency across the broader HR team as part of the shift to self-service.

 * Automate recurring recruiting reports to eliminate manual data wrangling.
 * Translate talent data into insights that identify pipeline bottlenecks, improve candidate experience, and improve hiring efficiency.
 * Monitor recruiting data for anomalies and build validation checks to establish one version of the truth across systems.

 * 2+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
 * Strong SQL and Python skills.
 * Direct experience extracting and modeling data from at least one major HRIS or ATS platform (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse) via its reporting or API layer. General dashboard-level reporting experience is not a substitute.
 * Demonstrated ability to build custom dashboards and data visualizations using standard BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau) or code-based environments (e.g., Python, Streamlit, Plotly).

 * Strong storytelling and presentation skills for both VP/executive and non-technical audiences.

 * A point of view on AI/LLM-based analytics tools and how they simplify insight delivery – direct experience implementing one is a plus.

As a Commercial Account Executive, Mid-Market, you’ll be the primary point of contact for prospective and existing customers in our mid-market segment, helping organizations modernize how they plan, build, secure, and ship software with GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll own a broad book of business in your territory and serve as a strategic, trusted advisor to your accounts as you prospect, run complex sales cycles, and guide customers on their journey with GitLab to achieve clear business outcomes while supporting adoption and reducing churn. posting.title: Manager, Client Platform Engineering
posting.description:
We are looking for a Manager, Client Platform Engineering to own MongoDB's endpoint platform worldwide. You'll lead a globally distributed team responsible for macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints, mobile device and application management, zero-touch provisioning, on-time operating system and patch delivery, and the endpoint telemetry that tells us how the fleet is performing for the people using it. You'll partner with InfoSec to harden the endpoint estate, and build and grow a team of passionate, curious experts in this space. This role combines deep hands-on end user computing expertise with the people leadership and judgment to set technical direction and communicate risk and strategy to stakeholders.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 *   Own the worldwide endpoint architecture and roadmap for macOS, Windows, Linux, and mobile, including management platform strategy, configuration-as-code, application packaging and self-service, and zero-touch provisioning
 *   Lead the release calendar and deployment ring strategy for every endpoint operating system, delivering major and minor updates on time to a published compliance target, with tested rollback and a clear exception path
 *   Administer and evolve MongoDB's endpoint management stack across MDM and UEM platforms, including declarative device management (DDM) on macOS and Windows Autopilot and Autopatch on Windows 11
 *   Own mobile strategy end to end for corporate-owned and BYOD devices across iOS and Android, balancing data protection against an enrollment experience employees will accept MDM where enrollment is appropriate, MAM and app protection policies where it is not
 *   Build and operate MongoDB's Endpoint Digital Employee Experience program: instrument the fleet, define the DEX metrics and SLOs we hold ourselves to, and drive proactive remediation that resolves issues before employees notice them
 *   Partner with InfoSec to implement and continuously improve endpoint security controls, including hardening baselines, patch and vulnerability remediation SLAs, disk encryption and key escrow coverage, device trust, and Conditional Access
 *   Serve as a senior technical escalation point (L3) for complex endpoint issues across the organization
 *   Build automation to reduce manual endpoint operations work and improve reliability and observability, holding the team to configuration-as-code, peer review, and staged rollout
 *   Act as a technical advisor for MongoDB's relationships with endpoint management, DEX, and hardware vendors, and own the endpoint tooling and licensing budget
 *   Hire, coach, and retain a globally distributed team of EUC engineers, and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and self-service


RESPONSIBILITIES

 *   Ensure MongoDB's global endpoint fleet remains reliable, secure, compliant, and scalable across every platform and region as the company grows
 *   Deliver operating system rollouts on time, every cycle, across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints
 *   Reduce risk and technical debt across endpoint management, patching, and device lifecycle
 *   Build and maintain a high-performing international team, and develop engineers into recognized experts in this space
 *   Communicate endpoint strategy, risk, and incidents clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
 *   Uphold strong engineering practices across endpoint documentation, automation, and change management
 *   Balance long-term platform architecture work with day-to-day operational support
 *   Define, publish, and manage the team against the metrics for the service


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 *   Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience
 *   8+ years of experience in end user computing, client platform engineering, or endpoint and modern workplace engineering, including 3+ years hiring and leading engineers
 *   Proven experience owning a fleet of several thousand endpoints across multiple countries and time zones
 *   Hands-on depth across all three desktop platforms, not oversight of them: macOS managed through a modern MDM (Jamf Pro, Iru/formerly Kandji, Microsoft Intune, or Omnissa Workspace ONE) with Apple Business (formerly Apple Business Manager) and Automated Device Enrollment; Windows 11 managed through Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Windows Autopatch; Linux endpoints managed as code with Ansible, Fleet, or equivalent
 *   A current understanding of Apple's declarative device management (DDM) model and what its adoption means for software update enforcement, Platform SSO, and configuration and app delivery
 *   Experience with both mobile management models: MDM for corporate-owned devices and MAM/app protection for BYOD, including Intune App Protection Policies, Android Enterprise work profile, and Apple User Enrollment with Managed Apple Accounts
 *   A demonstrated record of delivering major OS rollouts on schedule, with a defined ring strategy, compatibility gating, communications plan, exception process, and rollback path
 *   Experience instrumenting endpoints with a DEX or telemetry platform such as Nexthink, Lakeside SysTrack, ControlUp, 1E, Aternity, Intune Advanced Analytics, or osquery/Fleet, defining a score or SLO from it, and using it to resolve issues proactively
 *   Scripting skills for endpoint automation using infrastructure as code, with fluency in at least one of Bash, Python, Swift, or PowerShell and comfort with Git-based workflows
 *   Experience partnering with InfoSec, Identity, IT Service Delivery, and Workplace teams on cross-functional endpoint initiatives
 *   Experience leading engineers across multiple regions, with a clear approach to coverage, escalation, documentation, and asynchronous decision-making
 *   Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to a wide range of audiences
 *   Experience with endpoint documentation and reporting such as fleet compliance dashboards, configuration baselines, and operational runbooks
 *   There will be requirements from time to time to work across multiple time zones as required by the business, including travel


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 *   Jamf Certified Expert, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or equivalent endpoint management certification
 *   Visible standing in the endpoint community — MacAdmins Slack, Jamf Nation, Midwest Management Summit, Penn State MacAdmins — or open-source contributions to projects such as Munki, Installomator, Nudge, swiftDialog, or osquery
 *   Experience supporting a heavily technical employee population, including software engineers with elevated-privilege, virtualization, and local developer and AI tooling needs
 *   Experience with cloud identity and device trust platforms such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID, and with Conditional Access policy design
 *   Familiarity with ITSM practice, service ownership, and Experience Level Agreements (XLAs) alongside traditional SLAs
 *   Experience owning endpoint tooling budget, vendor relationships, and licensing at scale
 *   Experience mentoring other endpoint or systems engineers


SUCCESS MEASURES

 *   In 3 months, you will: Be fully onboarded with a thorough understanding of MongoDB's endpoint estate and policies, have met your team and key partners in every region, and have delivered a written assessment of the worldwide fleet — platform coverage, compliance posture, tooling, gaps, and top risks — with a prioritized plan and any approved roles actively in flight
 *   In 6 months, you will: Have your team at or above 90% of the approved hiring plan, have published the EUC service metrics and SLOs (OS and patch compliance, zero-touch provisioning rate, mean time to provision, DEX score, self-service resolution rate), have shipped at least one major OS release on schedule under a defined ring strategy, and have closed the highest-priority gaps identified in your assessment
 *   In 12 months, you will: Be recognized as the senior owner of MongoDB's global endpoint platform, operating a fully staffed, high-performing international team; consistently meeting your published OS and patch compliance targets across macOS, Windows, and Linux; running a measurable proactive remediation program with a demonstrated reduction in endpoint tickets per employee; and owning a twelve-month endpoint roadmap that InfoSec, IT, and Engineering leadership have endorsed


LOCATION & TRAVEL:

 *   This role is based in Palo Alto / San Francisco, CA, and candidates should be located within reasonable commuting distance of our Palo Alto and San Francisco offices
 *   The team operates with a flexible work arrangement, with in-person collaboration typically occurring 1–2 times per week
 *   This role involves travel and regular work across time zones to lead a globally distributed team and to support global office and regional IT initiatives


ABOUT MONGODB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

posting.title: Partner Sales Executive  (m/f/d)
posting.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Partner Sales Representative III to join our German Partner team in Berlin/Cologne/Munich! 

This is a hybrid role, requiring a minimum of two days per week in our office.

YOUR IMPACT

 * Convert high-value prospects: Demonstrate resourcefulness to connect and communicate value, provide optimal commercial conditions, and collaborate to ensure business objectives are met under conditions of critical importance to the client team's success.
 * Execute High-Volume Outbound Outreach: Systematically conduct 50+ cold calls per day, alongside targeted email and social media outreach, to identify and engage potential new partners.
 * Prospect and Qualify Leads: Research and identify key decision-makers within target businesses, qualifying their potential interest and fit for our platform.
 * Manage the Full Sales Cycle: Lead potential partners through every stage of the sales process, from initial contact and discovery to negotiation and closing.
 * Conduct Engaging Presentations: Articulate our value proposition clearly and persuasively, presenting the benefits of joining our network directly to business owners and decision-makers.
 * Negotiate and Close Deals: Confidently manage expectations, overcome objections, and finalize partnership agreements to bring new businesses onto the Wellhub platform.
 * Maintain CRM Accuracy: Diligently log all sales activities, prospect interactions, and update lead statuses in our CRM system (e.g., Salesforce) to ensure accurate pipeline reporting and effective funnel management.
 * Achieve Sales Quotas: Consistently meet and exceed quarterly sales quotas.
 * Collaborate and Learn: Work closely with the sales team and other departments to refine outreach and closing strategies, share best practices, and continuously improve your sales skills.
 * Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

 * Sales or Customer-Facing Experience: Experience in high-volume outbound roles with demonstrated experience managing the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing. Must have a strong record of customer interaction and consistently exceeding sales or conversion quotas.
 * Communication: you speak German at a native level (C1) and English fluently
 * Proactive team player: Consistently collaborates across departments, prioritizes shared success, and maintains adaptability and constructive communication to achieve organizational goals.
 * Exceptional Communication Skills: You possess a clear, confident, and persuasive verbal communication style, especially over the phone and in virtual presentations. Strong written communication for emails is also essential.
 * Customer Service Mindset: A genuine desire to help others and provide a positive experience, even when navigating complex conversations or handling objections.
 * Strong Time Management & Organization: Ability to manage a high volume of daily tasks, prioritize effectively, and maintain an organized sales pipeline in a fast-paced environment. You're skilled at tracking leads, scheduling follow-ups, and managing your calendar.
 * Resilience and Drive: A tenacious attitude with the ability to handle rejection gracefully and maintain a positive, persistent approach to achieving daily and monthly closing targets.
 * Coachability: Eagerness to learn, adapt, and apply feedback to continuously improve your sales and closing performance.
 * Tech Savvy: Comfortable using CRM software (Salesforce) and sales engagement tools for outreach, tracking, and managing your sales funnel.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

 FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!


Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!
This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here. 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

posting.title: Account Executive
posting.description:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
Want to make an impact by innovating how top global companies build teams and adapt to the Future of Work? As an Account Executive, you’ll have the opportunity to target and close net new accounts, as well as re-engage dormant accounts. Success in this role comes from your skills in researching potential customers, strategically engaging them, aligning Toptal’s value with their needs, and consistently closing new business. This is a full sales cycle role, which means you will be responsible for setting your own meetings through your prospecting and outreach.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Prospect, educate, qualify, and close leads and opportunities by engaging dormant accounts and performing lead-generation activities into new targeted accounts. Additionally, manage inbound leads, as required.
Conduct outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn to convey Toptal’s vision, identify opportunities, present Toptal’s value proposition, and secure new business.
Effectively manage the sales funnel to optimize lead progression, coordinate communication among various stakeholders, and diligently follow up on accounts to nurture leads toward conversion.
As you become more comfortable in the role, you’ll help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
Grasp the importance of the outbound function to the success of growing Toptal.
Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.
In the first month, expect to:
Complete our personalized sales training program, complete with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
Learn how to use outreach tools (SalesLoft, Zoominfo, SalesNavigator).
Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.
In the first three months, expect to:
While exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities with existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.
In the first six months, expect to:
Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
Assist with training and onboarding new Account Executives.
Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnership with new and existing clients.
Suggest, implement and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.
In the first year, expect to:
Have closed multiple net new accounts from the strategic account list, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper business development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.
Consistently maintain a high level of success by meeting and exceeding 100% of monthly and quarterly key performance indicators and targets.
Establish a career path for advancement.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
The ideal candidate will bring at least 1 year of closing experience.
You are persistent. Being rejected by prospective clients can be a common occurrence in this role. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks. Being enthusiastic, ambitious, and having a positive mindset will play a key role in your success.
You are naturally curious. You have a strong desire to understand people, their problems, companies, and industries. If/when you come across a complex issue, you can understand and explain them to clients.
You thrive with autonomy and ownership. We’re looking for someone who can be held accountable for leading their portion of the business. To succeed at Toptal, you need to be a world-class individual contributor. Part of this includes being able to take ownership of your accounts, successes, and failures.
You are a go-getter. We are looking for self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts and think about target accounts as their own business. You aren’t afraid to do the work required to reach your goals by following a process and being creative.
You don’t take yourself too seriously; you have a sense of humor and are comfortable with sarcasm. This position does sit on our Sales teams, after all.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

posting.title: Client Advisor
posting.description:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary
Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.
You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptal’s value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.
You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptal’s full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.
Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.
Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the client’s concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the client’s needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the client’s broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. posting.description:

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.
In the first month, expect to:
Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.
In the first three months, expect to:
Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.
In the first six months, expect to:
Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.
Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.
In the first year, expect to:
Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.
Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR.
Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients.
Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts.
Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.
Conscientiousness. We’re not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.
Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.
Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.
Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.
Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies.
Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts.
Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures.
Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks.
Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Corporate IT Engineer to our Corporate IT team in Brazil - Remote! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

CorpIT builds scalable, data-driven solutions that raise Wellhubber productivity across the organization. This role sits at the center of that mandate: you will be the technical owner and strategic voice for the platforms that every Wellhubber touches daily, balancing hands-on administration with long-term technology and vendor strategy. Reporting directly to the Corporate IT Director, you will act as a high-level technical lead and individual contributor, driving strategic partnerships with global vendors, managing enterprise AI capabilities, and collaborating across infrastructure, infosec, and executive leadership without people-management overhead.

 * Own the end-to-end administration, configuration, and lifecycle management of our core corporate IT platforms (including Google Workspace, access tools, and endpoint ecosystems) from discovery to retirement.

 * Establish and maintain a multi-quarter technology roadmap for all owned platforms, anticipating future business needs, evaluating market innovations, and executing time-bound milestones.
 * Lead vendor relationship management end-to-end, steering contract renewals, pricing negotiations, SLA enforcement, and technical escalations directly with global tech partners.

WHO YOU ARE

Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Platform Engineer with a dedicated focus on our Observability ecosystem for our Platform area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil. 

Wellhub runs at high scale, on many Kubernetes clusters. Our engineers need logs, metrics, traces and profiles they can trust, at a cost the business can sustain. We build and run this platform ourselves, on open source standards. This is not a "keep the lights on" role. You will help decide how a large platform is built, where it should stay simple, and what we should stop collecting. We value people who question the problem before they design the solution.

What you will work on:

 * A self-service platform. Observability as a Service for the whole engineering organization, balancing performance and cost.
 * Golden Paths. Defaults that let a developer instrument code in minutes and get good signals without operating anything.
 * The platform itself. Kubernetes and AWS foundations that stay reliable when the company grows.

Our stack includes Kubernetes, AWS, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Crossplane, HashiCorp Vault, Kafka, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Tempo and Pyroscope. You will write code in Go, Ruby or Python to build our tools.

 

YOUR IMPACT

Our team does not run services for other teams. We build tools and abstractions so each team can own and run its own services end to end.

Your work will rest on four things: stability, performance, cost and evolution of the platform. In this role you will:

 * Review our current platform with fresh eyes. Say what is wrong, propose better solutions, and help the team evolve them. Your outside view is part of the job.
 * Design and evolve cloud-native platform components on Kubernetes and AWS.
 * Close the gap between complex infrastructure and developer experience. Build the abstractions (defaults, templates, CLIs, operators) that let teams manage their own observability.
 * Find the root cause of cost, reliability and developer-experience problems, and fix it at the platform level.
 * Set standards and guidelines, and write them down through RFCs.
 * Work with the whole team day to day: pair on designs, review proposals and mentor engineers as a technical reference. Our stack is open source and we use AI tools every day, so you can contribute early. Our team learned observability on the job, and anyone on the team can help you.
 * Live the mission: care for your own wellbeing and your colleagues'. Help build a team where people feel safe to take time off and keep a healthy work-life balance.

 

WHO YOU ARE

You have strong cloud and Kubernetes foundations, you like hard platform problems, and you do not need to be an observability expert yet.

You like to remove friction. You want your work to help many engineers. You learn fast, and you tell us what you do not know.

This role may fit if you have:

 * Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and its ecosystem, from running real clusters.
 * You possess excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese.
 * Proficiency with AWS (or GCP or Azure) in production. Networking, IAM, cost and failure modes feel familiar.
 * Strong software engineering skills. You write code to remove manual work and to build tools for other engineers.
 * Experience in platform engineering, SRE or infrastructure, in a company where many teams depend on your work.
 * Experience using observability in production (metrics, logs or traces), with any tool. We do not require our exact stack.

Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

You will help evolve our referral program as a scalable growth channel, creating experiences that drive acquisition and engagement, while also building and improving the capabilities that enable a sustainable marketplace.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, design, engineering, operations, business stakeholders, and other product teams to deliver high-quality products that meet both Wellhub's goals and clients' needs.
